lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 was the reviewer's round-1 fix for CAM-63's doc-sync gap: scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md step 8 (and its templates/ copy) still read 'Update the PRD to set passes: true for the completed story', contradicting the sole-writer convention this PRD introduces (US-003 made the supervisor the sole writer, US-005 removed the flip-instruction from the implementer prompts, US-006 mechanically denies a worker Write to prd.json). Reworded both copies' step 8 to 'Do not edit prd.json. The supervisor is the sole writer of passes: true, and it flips it only after reading your worker-report.json.' Ran embed-vendor (templates/ is the embed source of truth; the generic templates-dir embed picks up scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md too, not just agents/) + embed-vendor:check clean. The reviewer's own review-round machinery had already written the US-R1-001 story entry plus prd.review (roundsCompleted:1, lastVerdict FIXES_PENDING:1, findings array) directly into scripts/cam/prd.json on disk before this story was dispatched; I did not Write-edit prd.json myself (denied by the US-006 hook for CAM_WORKER actor) but did `git add`+commit it as part of 'commit ALL changes', consistent with the reviewer-writes/implementer-commits convention documented in patterns.md's Findings-durability-channels bullet. A SECOND finding from the same review round is still open and NOT addressed by this story: a SUGGESTION (non-blocking) in src/supervisor/host.ts:930 noting aheadByForBranch and commitExistsForStory share duplicated spawnSync-git+fetch+range-fallback scaffolding -- left as-is since SUGGESTIONs are non-blocking and no US-R1-002 story was filed for it in this dispatch. Next dispatch should re-run review (round 2) to check whether FIXES_PENDING clears to CLEAN now that the WARNING finding is resolved.
